name: NYCHA Citywide Special Events
description:
This dataset lists special events held at New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) locations citywide. Each of the 368 sampled rows records an event's title, location, recurrence flag, and start time. The recurrence field is binary, with about 6% of events marked as recurring and the rest as one-time. Titles cover a wide range of public programming, such as holiday parties, training academy sessions, information sessions, and cultural celebrations, and locations include offices, courts, and other venues across the city. Start times are given as timestamps, mostly spanning late 2013 into 2014.

The data can be used to build community event calendars, compare how often and where events take place across NYCHA sites, identify gaps in programming, and support outreach or recreation planning. It could also support analysis of access to community activities in public housing neighborhoods.
